units.source_text: 一个饭店的阳台，四周的树木刚刚萌芽。

en.t: On the balcony of a restaurant, the trees all around had just begun to bud.

units.source_text: 他在那里一边作画，一边和一个少年玩耍。

en.t: There, he painted while playing with a young boy.

units.source_text: 这个少年是七年前分手的狂人的女儿的独子。

en.t: This boy was the only son of the madman's daughter, from whom he had parted seven years earlier.
